characters.name: Baby Moses
characters.description: A cute newborn baby boy, simple soft rounded features, innocent facial expression, large expressive eyes, wrapped in soft white and earth-tone cloths.
characters.notes: Chibi-like proportions. Very innocent and soft.

characters.name: Mother (Jochebed)
characters.description: A loving Israelite mother with a gentle, worried face. Large expressive eyes, wearing simple natural earth-tone clothing (linen). Soft rounded features.
characters.notes: Shows a mix of deep love and sadness.

characters.name: Sister (Miriam)
characters.description: A young Israelite girl, about 7 years old. Chibi-like proportions, large expressive eyes, simple natural clothing. Brave and watchful expression.
characters.notes: Often seen hiding behind reeds or looking from a distance.

characters.name: Egyptian Princess
characters.description: A kind and beautiful Egyptian princess. Elegant but soft features, large expressive eyes. Wearing white linen with subtle gold ornaments, but keeping the soft pastel watercolor style.
characters.notes: Her expression is compassionate and gentle.

characters.name: Pharaoh
characters.description: A stern Egyptian king. Wearing an Egyptian headdress, but keeping the art style soft and simple.
characters.notes: Appears in the background or briefly.

characters.name: God
characters.description: 神様のキャラクター表現。画像生成は行わず、既存のアセット（adam_and_eve）を流用するため、プロンプトには使用しません。
